title: Technical Services Manager
desc:
We are looking for a
Technical Services Manager
for our global business partner operating in the medical sector.
Job Description
- Manage Technical Services operations effectively and efficiently,
- Lead technical teams and team leaders,
- Ensure high standards of quality, efficiency and customer satisfaction,
- Drive process improvement and operational excellence initiatives,
- Collaborate with global teams and adapt international procedures and best practices to local operations,
- Monitor operational KPIs and take necessary actions,
- Develop workflows and procedures to improve service operations,
- Lead team development, performance management and employee engagement,
- Manage technical requests from customers and business partners.
Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Engineering,
- At least 10 years of relevant experience in technical service, technical operations, & repair or similar fields
- Proven experience in team and team leader management,
- Good command of English with active daily use,
- Experience in process improvement and project management,
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and leadership skills,
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills,
- Proficiency in MS Office,
- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally when required.
Experience in medical devices, biomedical, electronics, electromechanical systems, technical service or similar technical operations will be considered an advantage.
